newsitem.title: USA: Meadow Valley sees Q3 net as estimated.
newsitem.headline: Meadow Valley sees Q3 net as estimated.

text.p: Meadow Valley Corp said on Tuesday that it expected net income for the third quarter ending September 30 to be consistent with analyst estimates of $360,000 or $0.10 per share, on revenue of about $33 million.

In the same period last year, the company earned net income of $401,000 or $0.34 per share, on revenue of $27.1 million. There were 3.6 million shares outstanding compared to 1.2 mllion share last year, it said.
The First Call mean estimate for the third quarter was $0.21 per share.

Meadow Valley said it had a record backlog of $148 million, of which about $30 million was set for completion in the fourth quarter of 1996. The heavy construction contractor said it expected to report third quarter financial results on or about Nov. 5, 1996.
